name: Jeff Staple x Nike Dunk Low Pro SB 'Panda Pigeon'
story_html: Originally conceived as a sample colorway that was initially rejected, the Jeff Staple x Dunk Low Pro SB ‘Panda Pigeon’ continues Staple’s long-running partnership with Nike SB. The design lives up to its name with a black and white color scheme on the leather and suede upper, complete with the all-important pigeon on the lateral heel. A translucent outsole reveals a collage made up of newspaper headlines alluding to the infamous Pigeon Dunk launch from 2005.
